name: get_tree
description: Returns filtered structure without contents. Use it to find files by name; use get_file instead for file content. Returns Markdown/text/JSON/XML within 2,000 lines and 50,000 characters. paths selects literal locations; include_patterns selects names or directories in one call, e.g. include_patterns=["src/middleware/{powered-by,body-limit,bearer-auth}/**/*handler*.ts"]. format=markdown|text|json|xml; max_depth=0..1000 counts levels below each paths entry, or the project root without paths; filters only narrow.

arguments.name: paths
arguments.desc: Narrows selection to literal paths for existing project-relative files or directories; glob characters are ordinary.

arguments.name: include_patterns
arguments.desc: Narrows with project-relative '/' globs: '*' and '?' stay in one segment, '**/' spans depths, and '{a,b}' alternates; matching is case-sensitive, while '!' and '[...]' are rejected.

arguments.name: exclude_patterns
arguments.desc: Removes paths with the same project-relative glob syntax as include_patterns.

arguments.name: max_depth
arguments.desc: Limits levels below each requested paths entry, or below the project root when paths is omitted; omit it for the deepest complete tree that fits.

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: Selects the tree representation; markdown is the compact default.

name: read_pack
description: Reads a stored result page created by search_project or related_files. Use its pack_id; use search_project for evidence or related_files for dependencies when no valid stored result exists. Returns untrusted data up to 1,000 lines or 50,000 characters with trusted continuation or range notes. Protection changes invalidate stored content; selection-only changes retain it with a warning. Ranges and columns are inclusive and 1-based.

arguments.name: pack_id
arguments.desc: Session id returned by search_project or related_files.

arguments.name: start_line
arguments.desc: First 1-based returned-text line; accepts integer or numeric string.

arguments.name: end_line
arguments.desc: Last inclusive 1-based returned-text line; accepts integer or numeric string.

arguments.name: start_column
arguments.desc: First 1-based Unicode character on start_line; use a returned continuation value.

name: search_project
description: Searches transformed text with a timed .NET regex. It matches file content, never paths; find names with get_tree include_patterns. Use it for symbols or phrases; symbols=true finds declarations, not uses; use related_files for dependency links. Returns grouped numbered matches, merged context, complete|partial status, inspected/retained/written counts, and continuation. Line numbers use returned text; generated redaction replacements never match. Key parameters: pattern, paths, context_lines, ignore_case, max_results=1..200, include_patterns, exclude_patterns, and max_file_bytes. The best unique declaration includes up to 1,800 protected body characters within the same cap.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.desc: Required .NET regex with a 2-second timeout over redacted file content, never paths; use get_tree include_patterns for names. Text inserted by redaction never matches.

arguments.name: paths
arguments.desc: Narrows selection to literal paths for existing project-relative files or directories; glob characters are ordinary.

arguments.name: include_patterns
arguments.desc: Narrows with project-relative '/' globs: '*' and '?' stay in one segment, '**/' spans depths, and '{a,b}' alternates; matching is case-sensitive, while '!' and '[...]' are rejected.

arguments.name: exclude_patterns
arguments.desc: Removes paths with the same project-relative glob syntax as include_patterns.

arguments.name: max_file_bytes
arguments.desc: Excludes selected files larger than this byte count; accepts an integer or numeric string.

arguments.name: context_lines
arguments.desc: Context lines per match; overlapping windows merge.

arguments.name: ignore_case
arguments.desc: Enables case-insensitive matching; accepts a boolean or its string form.

arguments.name: symbols
arguments.desc: Match declarations of the name in pattern (Foo, class Foo, Foo|Bar), not uses; a regular expression is searched as text instead.

arguments.name: max_results
arguments.desc: Limits displayed match lines while scanning continues; the boundary reports encountered, retained, and written counts.

name: related_files
description: Get dependencies and usages of a file: who uses it, what it imports, and which tests import it, from real imports and references rather than text search. Use it before changing a file or to review a change; use search_project for text and get_file for content. Takes one to 16 seed files; a narrowed call also names readable files outside its selection. Returns paths with evidence, resolution status and token estimates; results above 50,000 characters use read_pack. Key parameters: path, direction=dependencies|dependents|both, and include_patterns.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Seed file, or up to 16 seed files, within the effective selection; a folder stands for the files directly inside it.

arguments.name: direction
arguments.desc: Chooses outward dependencies, inward dependents, or both.

arguments.name: include_patterns
arguments.desc: Narrows with project-relative '/' globs: '*' and '?' stay in one segment, '**/' spans depths, and '{a,b}' alternates; matching is case-sensitive, while '!' and '[...]' are rejected.

name: get_file
description: Reads project files with secrets and configured private data replaced. Use it after get_tree or search_project; use batched requests for several known files. path reads one file, optionally with start_line/end_line or symbol; paths reads up to sixteen whole files; requests mixes files, ranges, and symbols: requests=[{"path":"src/a.ts","symbol":"Router.load"}]. A batch returns files whole in the order asked, within 50,000 characters; a large file, or one that no longer fits, returns its structure with line ranges. Items report ok, structure, partial, not-returned, or unavailable. Line numbers refer to returned text.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: One file, or an array of up to sixteen whole files. Give path, paths, or requests; path and paths may accompany requests and add whole-file reads. Names an existing selected file; Markdown escapes from the default get_tree format are accepted, while format=text supplies literal names.

arguments.name: paths
arguments.desc: Up to sixteen files read whole in one call; with start_line and end_line, the same lines are read from each file.

arguments.name: requests
arguments.desc: Batch form: up to sixteen files and sixteen selections; a path reads the whole file, while ranges or symbol narrow it. start_line, end_line, and start_column cannot accompany requests.

arguments.name: start_line
arguments.desc: First 1-based returned-text line; accepts integer or numeric string.

arguments.name: end_line
arguments.desc: Last inclusive 1-based returned-text line; accepts integer or numeric string.

arguments.name: start_column
arguments.desc: First 1-based Unicode character on start_line; use a returned continuation value.

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.desc: Reads a qualified, or file-unique simple, declaration with path instead of a range; search_project supplies names. Cannot combine with line or column fields; missing, unavailable, or non-unique declarations return DPX-MCP-INVALID-ARGUMENTS.

name: get_diff
description: Shows what changed: masked unified diff hunks for a Git scope. Use it to review staged, uncommitted or ref-to-ref changes; use get_file for whole files and search_project for text. Returns per-file status, added/removed counts and hunks with context, largest changes first, under the same secret and private-data redaction as file content, with complete|partial status within 50,000 characters. Key parameters: git_scope=changes|staged|diff:A..B (default changes), paths, include_patterns, context_lines=0..20.

arguments.name: git_scope
arguments.desc: Chooses the comparison: changes is HEAD to the working tree including untracked files, staged is HEAD to the index, and diff:<ref>..<ref> compares two commits.

arguments.name: paths
arguments.desc: Narrows selection to literal paths for existing project-relative files or directories; glob characters are ordinary.

arguments.name: include_patterns
arguments.desc: Narrows with project-relative '/' globs: '*' and '?' stay in one segment, '**/' spans depths, and '{a,b}' alternates; matching is case-sensitive, while '!' and '[...]' are rejected.

arguments.name: context_lines
arguments.desc: Unchanged lines around each change; hunks whose context touches merge.
